rubrics: The response should begin with a succinct summary of the single biggest difference between the guides, “H2C AMS Combo” and “H2C Full Laser Combo.” For example, it could say, "The Full Laser Combo adds laser/cutting capabilities and related ventilation/assembly steps, while the AMS Combo focuses on multi‑material automatic spool management (AMS)."

The response should list the concrete hardware differences between the H2C AMS Combo and the H2C Full Laser Combo. For example, the presence of a laser/cutting module, mention of an air-pump mounting screw to remove, Birdseye camera included in Full Laser, AMS 2 Pro components present in both.

The response should identity all of the differences in safety and operational requirements that affect setup or use. For example, "The Full Laser guide instructs leaving 30 cm at the back for a smoke ventilation pipe and removing induction hotends before using the laser; the AMS guide emphasizes AMS drying and filament handling."

The response should compare sensor and camera differences using the exact camera types and resolutions stated in the manuals, “H2C AMS Combo” and “H2C Full Laser Combo.” For example, "Full Laser: BirdsEye Camera 3264×2448; AMS Combo: Live View/Nozzle/Toolhead cameras 1920×1080."

The response should list the differences in included accessories or tools between “H2C AMS Combo” and “H2C Full Laser Combo.” For example, additional brackets, smoke ventilation parts, or air pump-related hardware in the Full Laser Combo.

The response should cite the exact section title or heading from the provided guides for every asserted difference. For example, "Full Laser Combo — 'BirdsEye Camera' section" or "Read before use" safety paragraph.

The response should include an explicit note about any operational restrictions tied to hardware differences. For example, whether laser use requires an extra quick start guide or removes induction hotends before laser use, as is stated in the guides. For example: "Full Laser Combo — 'Please remember to take off all induction hotends before using the laser'."
The response should state “same in both” or “not specified in the provided guides” for categories (e.g., Hardware, Setup/Safety) where no difference is evidenced, to avoid implying differences.

The response should not assert any differences that are not supported by the pasted guide text. For example, if a likely difference is not explicitly stated in the documents, the response should say "not specified in the provided guides" rather than guessing.
